crossRefs.note: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, “I will be king.” Then he prepared him chariots and horsemen…
Nathan said, “My lord, king, have you said, ‘Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne?’
But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, “As soon as you hear the sound of the trumpet, then…
Then Nathan spoke to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, “Haven’t you heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith…
Nathan said, “My lord, king, have you said, ‘Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne?’
Was this thing done by my lord the king, and you haven’t shown to your servants who should sit on the throne of my lord…
“Now, brothers, I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.

people.name: Adonijah
people.line: Son of David who attempted to seize the throne

translations.web: Now, behold, Adonijah reigns; and you, my lord the king, don’t know it.
translations.bsb: But now, behold, Adonijah has become king, and you, my lord the king, do not know it.
translations.kjv: And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and now, my lord the king, thou knowest it not:
translations.asv: And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and thou, my lord the king, knowest it not:
